title: Knight moves and shortest knight distance on 8x8
requirements: moves(square) returns the knight's legal destinations on an 8x8 board, sorted (moves('b1') == ['a3', 'c3', 'd2'])
distance(a, b) returns the minimum number of knight moves between two squares (0 for the same square)
(after the user switch) path(a, b) returns one shortest route as a list of squares from a to b inclusive
user_messages: knight.moves(square) → sorted list of where a knight can jump from there on a normal 8x8 board, e.g. moves('b1') == ['a3', 'c3', 'd2']
knight.distance(a, b) → fewest knight moves between two squares, 0 if it's the same square
can you add path(a, b) that gives an actual shortest route, list of squares from a to b including both ends?
